instruction: Stack the smooth bowl with glossy finish on top of the small smooth brown-rimmed bowl.

source.instruction: Stack the smooth bowl with glossy finish on top of the small smooth brown-rimmed bowl.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the bowl1, which was at x = +19 (right half of the table); the LEFT arm grasped the bowl2, which was at x = -11 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Point right arm down, move towards the brown-rimmed bowl at (25.5, -12, 89).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-5, +7, -5) cm, now 7 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the bowl1

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (25, -12, 89) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm to z=78.5 to grasp the rim of the brown-rimmed bowl and close gripper.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -10) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the bowl1; closed the gripper (opening 0.16: holding the bowl1)

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (25, -12, 79) opening 0.16; table z = 74

frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +10) cm, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +6 cm (vertical) from the bowl1

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (25, -12, 89) opening 0.11; table z = 74

frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-15, +2, +0) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the bowl1

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (10, -10, 89) opening 0.10; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower brown-rimmed bowl onto the table at z=81 and release gripper.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-4, +0, -8) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +7 cm (vertical) from the bowl1; opened the gripper

frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +8) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the bowl1

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, -10, 90) opening 0.94; table z = 74

frames.label: turn 8

frames.plan: Send right arm to home position to clear workspace.

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-17, -1, 89) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
